pages.text: Hunt, tame, and harvest your way through 80+ new creatures, from bald eagles and grizzly bears to void worms and laviathans. Most are passive or neutral, but several are dangerous hunters.

$(bold)Notable creatures:$() The $(bold)Void Worm$() (end boss), $(bold)Cachalot Whale$() (ocean), $(bold)Laviathan$() (sky), and $(bold)Murmur$() (underground) are boss-tier fights. Most creatures drop their own materials, used in Apotheosis gem crafting.$(br2)$(bold)In IridescentCraft:$() several Alex's Mobs creatures appear in boss loot tables and drop tokens.
$(bold)Craft the Animal Dictionary$() for a full bestiary: every creature, its drops, its habitat, and whether you can tame or ride it.
